title: Matrix-free tangent matvec emission
objective: Emit Taichi function for tangent matrix-vector product with push-forward, geometric stiffness, and BC enforcement.
implementation_steps: Emit material tangent contribution to matvec
Emit push-forward of tangent through deformation gradient
Verify matvec result matches finite-difference/assembled comparison on one element
acceptance_criteria: Matvec result matches finite-difference tangent on single element
Matvec result matches assembled stiffness comparison
BC enforcement zeros constrained DOF contributions

cases: BC enforcement: constrained DOFs produce zero

risks: Geometric stiffness term easy to get wrong — verify with FD comparison
Push-forward must be consistent with TL formulation
